source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "urban planning" AND (planners OR "planning system" OR "planning systems" OR "planning practice" OR "planning policy" OR "planning politics" OR "politics of planning" OR "planning regime")
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"urban planning" AND (planners OR "planning system" OR "planning systems" OR "planning practice" OR "planning policy" OR "planning politics" OR "politics of planning" OR "planning regime"),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("urban planning" AND ("planning policy" OR "planning politics" OR "planning practice" OR "planning regime" OR "planning system" OR "planning systems" OR "politics of planning" OR "planners"))
